headline: Stadtforum in Dresden / Tchoban Voss Architekten
context: During redevelopment of the area around the historical Ferdinandplatz in the center of Dresden , the first prize in a design competition held for Stadtforum, the city's new administrative center, was won by a proposal submitted by TCHOBAN VOSS Architekten and Barcode Architects.
